method: Read-only reconciliation of the user-provided review synthesis against retained SH9-SH17 artifacts, the live post-SH16 registry/materializer, and the preserved SH2-D1 prototype patch. No completed benchmark, primitive microbench, profiler run, or category oracle was repeated.

hardware_scope.system: Framework Desktop / AMD Ryzen AI MAX+ 395

sh9_d1_scope.detail: SH9-D1 is multi-row prefill-only: 40 synchronous copies and 40 copy-kernel dispatches are removed per pp512 request, with no c1 decode or memory credit.

production_snapshot.qualification: The synthesis snapshot is pre-SH16. The current production default has fork-F16 whole-GTT parity at 512/32K/64K, still misses 4K by 134.820 MiB, and misses fork-F16 decode at all four depths.

exact_and_lifecycle_gates.detail: The promoted SH16 default passes 18/18 primary+heldout prompts, 1,350/1,350 token and 54,000/54,000 hidden comparisons, exact initial/final state, deterministic repeats, and zero tracked ownership after close. No gate was repeated for this read-only audit.

SH10-A1.detail: The actual 512 private-c1 context owner was attributed and the already-registered fixed256 exact leaf was promoted through active context 1023. It reduces the complete attention role by 0.572 ms/token and passes byte/state/prefill/memory/lifecycle/resource gates.

SH11-A1.detail: The current forced-direct 4K route diverges in all four teacher-forced decode transitions and is 37.788% slower; no exact-emulation package was admitted.

SH12-C0.detail: The complete eager c1 sync/copy census classified the boundaries and removed only the redundant default-stream sample drain; cached tracing changes 20 to 10 device synchronizations with unchanged copies and launches.

SH13-M1.detail: The 4K phase census found only 3.497 MiB of HSA code objects and at most 0.719 MiB eligible before the already-reached prefill peak, far below the then-current 346.820-MiB gap; no dlclose/lazy loader was added.

SH14-C1.detail: The four-depth cumulative wall/GTT, complete 18-prompt exact oracle, lifecycle, and named-resource gate was run. Its production snapshot was later superseded by retained SH16 allocation ownership.

post_sh14_compound.novelty: The proposed cross-leaf composition was not previously run as one full-model A/B. Its three primitive projections came from separate exact screens that were removed below their individual gates.

selected_down_output_tiled_tail.role: 37 Q5 plus 3 Q6 selected-down layers and exact ordered route/shared-gate/residual tail

preserved_prototype_patch.qualification: Transient local evidence only; not committed and not a production source dependency.

compatibility_audit.gdn_q8t16_layout: Compatible with the current unchanged gguf_q8_0_t16_v1 weight layout, but its candidate kernel/wrapper/registry entry was intentionally removed.
compatibility_audit.selected_q4_layout: Compatible with the current unchanged legacy gguf_q4_k_t16_v1 gate/up bytes, but the Qwen-shaped candidate kernel/wrapper/registry entry was intentionally removed.
compatibility_audit.q6_down_layout: Compatible for the model's 3 legacy gguf_q6_k_t16_v1 down tensors.

q5_down_layout.prototype_access: Q5_T16_BLOCK_BYTES with expanded Q5_T16_SCALE_OFFSET/Q5_T16_MIN_OFFSET byte planes
q5_down_layout.production_access: Q5_QMICRO_T16_BLOCK_BYTES with 24-bit metadata records unpacked through qmicro_unpack_record before arithmetic
source_evidence: hipengine/kernels/hip_gfx1100/quant/gguf_t16_selected_gemv.hip:2890-2940 implements the current qmicro metadata unpack and tile8 arithmetic
/tmp/hipengine-sh2-d1-prototypes.patch uses Q5_T16_BLOCK_BYTES and expanded scale/min offsets for the old tail

decision.reason: The only projection that puts the proposed sum above 0.5 ms/token is the 37-layer Q5 legacy-T16 tail, but production no longer has that representation. A qmicro-aware tail would be a new kernel with different metadata transport/resources and cannot inherit the legacy 0.055439-ms projection. The directly compatible subset projects only 0.475049 ms/token. Under the synthesis's explicit compatibility-first rule, no compound full-model A/B is admitted.
decision.new_qmicro_tail_reason: Its entire inherited upside is only 0.055439 ms/token and no current-layout leaf measurement establishes it; inventing it solely to rescue a summed projection would violate the new-evidence and no-retry rules.

explicit_exclusions.raw_lm_head_local64: Already closed; no new memory-bandwidth premise supplied.
explicit_exclusions.host_embedding_plus_compact_kv: Already measured as independent owners; compact KV loses decode and raises peak, so no stack is reopened.
explicit_exclusions.memlock: Already closed as a system setting, not a new owner; private-c1 host embedding already removes its device allocation where eligible.
explicit_exclusions.post_sh9_graph_replay: Confirmed excluded because SH9 removes prefill copies only and no eager decode graph break.
explicit_exclusions.generic_v_major_preload: Already closed; no new producer stall evidence supplied.
explicit_exclusions.closed_q8_attention_compact_kv_and_compo: No new mechanism evidence supplied; SH17 anti-retry remains in force.
explicit_exclusions.mtp: Correctly excluded from matched exact-AR fork parity.

lineage.result: No tracked external sources selected for either in-tree family; no external kernel body is being ported. The broad command remains blocked by the absent optional /home/lhl/amd-gpu-tuning/reference/atlas checkout.

final.next: Resume the read-only Nathan-fork upstream refresh in Task #67. Preserve SH16 production; implementation still requires genuinely new >=0.5-ms/token or >=134.820-MiB 4K evidence.
